observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR lens with visible text on the barrel: “AF-S NIKKOR” and “50mm 1/8G” (appears to be 50mm f/1.8G).
Photo 1 shows the side label area with “Nikon” and “AF-S NIKKOR” and the focal length/aperture marking; the front element is visible.
Photo 2 shows the front glass and the barrel text “Nikon” and “AF-S NIKKOR”; the lens appears to be in a plastic-wrapped condition.
No clear photo shows the lens mount contacts, full front glass at an angle for scratches, or the rear element clearly.

identity.model: AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G (read from photos as “50mm 1/8G” on the barrel)

claims.evidence: Photos only show a Nikon lens; no country-of-origin, import mark, or packaging is visible.
Photos show the lens, but do not provide decisive proof of internal haze/fungus, scratch-free glass, or perfect focusing/AF performance.

risks.risk: Hidden fungus/haze or internal dust on the glass that is not clearly visible in these photos
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the front and rear elements taken at an angle with a flashlight/phone light, plus a photo of the rear element/mount side.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed clean (worst case: possible haze/fungus), so value reduced vs like-new.

risks.risk: Scratches, coating damage, or chips on the front/rear glass not fully detectable from the current angles
risks.proof: Macro close-up of the front element edge-to-edge and the rear element, in sharp focus, with light raking across the surface.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially imperfect glass (worst case: minor scratches), not “like new.”

risks.risk: AF/motor performance issues (AF-S) or focus ring stiffness/backlash
risks.proof: Video of the lens focusing on a subject through the camera (showing AF lock) and a short clip of manual focus sweep.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working properly (worst case: AF not reliable).

risks.risk: Mount/contacts wear or damage (affects compatibility and metering)
risks.proof: Photo of the rear mount contacts (straight-on, well-lit) and the mount surface for dents/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used condition with possible mount wear (worst case: needs careful checking).

proof_requests: Send a sharp photo of the rear element and the rear mount contacts (straight-on, well-lit).
Send front and rear element close-ups with a flashlight/phone light at an angle to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Send a short video showing AF focusing and confirming it locks focus on a camera body.
response.reason: The lens identity (Nikon AF-S 50mm f/1.8G) is readable from the photos, but the seller’s “clean and like new” claim and working condition cannot be confirmed remotely without rear-element/mount and AF performance proof.
